H01.bug: Reset is sampled only on the clock edge instead of acting asynchronously.

H02.bug: Counter starts at 30 rather than 31 after reset, shortening the reset-release sequence by one cycle.

H03.bug: Counter decrements by two, skipping every other count value.

H04.bug: Clock gate remains enabled when the counter reaches zero.

H05.bug: Counter reloads to 31 when it reaches zero instead of holding at zero.

H06.bug: The counter increments instead of decrementing, so it never reaches zero after reset.

H07.bug: Counter updates on the falling edge of the clock instead of the rising edge.

H08.bug: Clock gate remains enabled at count 14 due to an inclusive upper boundary.

H09.bug: Reset release asserts at count 8 rather than only below 8.

H10.bug: Countdown stops at 1 instead of reaching zero.
